name: Rembrandt van Rijn
findings: Uses black 3.4x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 853 paintings here).
Uses smoky black 3.1x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 853 paintings here).
Uses raisin black 3.0x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 853 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, sand turns up as a small accent in 75% of the paintings that hold it, 6.3x the archive's rate (from 853 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, dark neutral grey turns up as the lightest note in 60% of the paintings that hold it, 4.3x the archive's rate (from 853 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, mahogany turns up as the shadow in 75% of the paintings that hold it, 2.2x the archive's rate (from 853 paintings here).
Pairs dim grey with nickel more than chance would predict (3 of 853 paintings here).
Pairs moss grey with quartz grey more than chance would predict (3 of 853 paintings here).
